Key EventsBusiness Updates
Q4
2025
On 28th October 2025, the Company was awarded the highest 5 -Star (“Excellent”) rating in the 2025 Corporate Governance Report 
(CGR) by the Thai Institute of Directors (IOD) for the third consecutive year.5 Star CGR Rating
On 20th October 2025, the Group achieved COD of a solar rooftop project in Buriram Province, with an installed capacity and a PPA 
capacity of 0.27 MW.Solar Rooftop Project COD
On 30th October 2025 , Don Mon biomass power plant in Buriram Province, with an installed capacity of 9.50 MW and a PPA capacity 
of 8.00 MW, reached the end of its PPA with the Provincial Electricity Authority (PEA).Expiry of Don Mon Biomass PPA
On 14th November 2025 , the Board of Directors ’ Meeting resolved to approve the disposal of the Repurchased Shares (Treasury 
Stock) under the share repurchase program conducted during the period from 1stJuly 2022 to 31stDecember 2022 , totaling 
100,365,600 shares, representing 0.99% of the total paid -up capital of the Company. The Repurchased Shares will be resold on the 
Stock Exchange of Thailand from 24thto 28thNovember 2025 .Disposal of Repurchased Shares
On 20th October 2025, the Company fully redeemed its Debenture No. 1/2023 (Series 1), with a tenor of 2 years and a total value of 
THB 235.20 million, upon the maturity date.Fully Redeemed Debenture on Maturity

## Page 7

7
Key EventsBusiness Updates
Q4
2025
On 28th November 2025 ,as the Company was unable to resell 100,365,600 Repurchased Shares, therefore, the Company has 
reduced its paid -up capital by writing off the Repurchased Shares. Subsequently, on 11thDecember 2025 , the Company has 
completed the registration of the decrease in paid -up capital, resulting in the Company ’s paid -up capital being decreased from 
10,175,999,960 shares to 10,075,634,360 shares, at a par value of THB 0.50 per share.Decrease of Paid -up Capital by Writing Off the Repurchased Shares
On 12th December 2025, the Company was awarded an “AAA” rating, the highest level, in the SET ESG Ratings 2025 by the Stock 
Exchange of Thailand, for the second consecutive year.“AAA” Rating in SET ESG Rating 2025
On 24th November 2025, the Supreme Administrative Court rendered its final judgment in the case concerning Alliance Clean Power 
Co., Ltd. (“ALCP”), an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the Company and the operator of the Si Sa Ket biomass power plant 
project. The Court upheld the Central Administrative Court’s decision dismissing ALCP’s claim against the termination of the PPA by 
the PEA. As a result, the project will be permanently discontinued.Supreme Administrative Court ’s Final Judgment on the Si Sa Ket Biomass Project
On 27th November 2025 , the Group achieved COD of a solar rooftop project located in Udon Thani Province, with an installed 
capacity and PPA capacity of 0.06 MW.Solar Rooftop Project COD
On 18th November 2025 , the Group achieved COD of a solar farm project in Ranong Province, with an installed capacity of 6.59 MW 
and a PPA capacity of 3.28 MW.Ranong Solar Farm Project COD

## Page 8

8
Key EventsBusiness Updates
Q1
2026
On 13th March 2026, The Board of Directors ’ Meeting No. 2/2026 resolved to approve the annual dividend payment for the operating 
results of the year 2025 in cash at the rate of THB 0.01 per share. The Record Date for determining the shareholders entitled to 
receive the dividend will be 27thMarch 2026 , and the dividend payment will be made on 28thMay 2026 .Board Resolution on Annual Dividend Payments
On 27th February 2026, the Group achieved COD of a solar farm project in Nong Kai Province , with an installed capacity of 11.63MW 
and a PPA capacity of 5.78 MW.Sri Chiang Mai Solar Farm Project COD
On 16th March 2026, the Group achieved COD of a solar farm project in Kamphaeng Phet Province, with an installed capacity of 
15.09 MW and a PPA capacity of 7.51 MW.Salokbat Solar Farm Project COD
